summary: Ran the full skipper use case end to end at 390px as test-admin-1 / main, with a 1920px check of the choices dialog. The boat was backed up to /tmp/bk175/boat.json, seeded with /tmp/seed175.py and restored afterwards with mongoimport --mode=upsert. The seeded arrivingDest has 26 items: Brief crew, Ready boat hooks, If berthing(3), If anchoring(3), If mooring only(4), Avoid lines, Close trip report, Stop Systems(3), and the When leaving berth / weighing anchor / leaving mooring groups (3 each). There was also an unrelated TEST_ log entry. PASSED: (1) DEPART on Leaving Dock (Mana Marina -> Tawa Bay) works. The window and toast are correct, and legs[routeHazards] = [dock leg with logs [status id, Departed id]]. (2) ARRIVED on Arriving at Destination with no arrival levels shows all-done-blocked and no choices. (3) With levels set there is no all-done-confirm-btn. all-done-choices has 3 buttons, each with an svg icon. The counts are correct: berth 10, anchor 10, mooring 11, each reading 'Ticks N items: the ones for every arrival, plus everything under If <x>'. (4) After the Mooring, Berth and Anchor choices the ticks in the DB were exactly general (1,2,40,41,50,51,52) plus that If group, and the other If and When leaving groups were unticked. The leg got arrival 'mooring'/'berth'/'anchor' and its logs got [arrival status id, Arrived id]. (5) The log label reads 'Arrived, all arrival checks done, Arrive Mooring (Arriving at Destination) - ...'. (6) The New departure dialog validation still works: no finish time gives the required error; 00:01 gives the 'before the Departure' error; the label has no '(optional)'. Leave Mooring, Leave Berth and Weigh Anchor each appended a leg with logs [entry id] and reset arrive to {}. No error toasts with no shore contacts. (7) Returning to Dock ARRIVED shows all-done-confirm-btn, no choices, and all-done-step-fold 'Fold this trip's 4 legs...'. The confirm folded everything into ONE entry, 'Trip - Route Plan: Route Planning - Mana Marina to Mana Marina, 14/11/2026 - 14/11/2026 - 4 legs - <stamp>'. Its detail has Leg 1-4 in order with the right kinds: Leaving Dock->Arrive Mooring, Leave Mooring->Arrive Berth, Leave Berth->Drop Anchor, Weigh Anchor->Returning to Dock. Then 'Ship's Log entries folded into this trip:' lists all 13 old entries. Every per-leg entry was removed from the log, the 2 unrelated entries stayed, legs[trip]=[] and underway={}. NOTE: the use case gives 4 legs, not the 5 in the request (4 departures: Leaving Dock, Leave Mooring, Leave Berth, Weigh Anchor). 4 is correct. (8) Returning to Dock with legs=[] shows no fold step and logs normally. (9) DEPART followed straight by Returning to Dock folds 1 leg. BUG FOUND: in that 1-leg trip the fold also took in a stale Arrival status entry from an earlier standalone Returning to Dock arrival, logged before this trip's DEPART. See the RCA. Weather photo combining was not tested (no photos were seeded). The regression test test_interim_legs.py passes 4/4.

ui_bugs.issue: The trip fold can take in Ship's Log entries from before the trip. boat.arrive (and boat.depart) keep log_id/log_sig after a trip ends. If the levels don't change, putLog reuses the existing entry id, and arrive() pushes arr.log_id into the current leg's logs. Reproduced: a standalone Returning to Dock arrival at 9:57 PM, then DEPART at 9:58 and Returning to Dock again. The new 1-leg Trip entry folded the 9:57 PM 'Arrival check (Returning to Dock)' entry, listed it first (before the Departure check), and logged no fresh arrival status for this trip. The same applies to the first arrival on Arriving at Destination after DEPART, and to DEPART's status entry when the old one is still in the log.

After a fold, the ARRIVED and DEPART windows say 'Arrival levels and what was used is already in the Ship's Log' or 'Tank and battery status is already in the Ship's Log'. The log_id entry was folded away, and putLog then adds a new entry anyway, so the text is wrong. statusStep should check that d.log_id still exists in shipsLog.

ui_bugs.component: arrivalSummary (arrival status entries for interim legs)
ui_bugs.issue: Every arrival status entry says 'Used on the passage Mana Marina to Tawa Bay', the overall Route Plan's start/dest, even for legs 2-4 (Tawa Bay->Picton, Picton->Anatohia, Anatohia->Mana). It should use the current leg's start/dest.

issues: The text in the choice buttons is centered, not left-aligned, even though the classes say justify-start/text-left. btn-solid probably overrides them. It still looks fine, but the icon sits apart from centered text.
Same-day legs show '14/11/2026 - 14/11/2026'. The fold title also gives the first leg's planned Departure (08:00) as 'departed', not the actual DEPART time (21:54).

action_items: HIGH: Stop the fold taking in pre-trip entries. In depart(), reset boat.arrive (at least log_id/log_sig), or force putLog to create a fresh entry. After the fold, clear arrive/depart log_id. Optionally only fold log ids created at or after legs[0].at.
MEDIUM: statusStep should treat log_id as done only if that id is still in shipsLog.
LOW: The arrival status 'Used on the passage X to Y' should use the current leg's start/dest (underway line / last leg), not boat.route_start/route_dest.
LOW: Left-align the text in the arrival choice buttons (btn-solid seems to force centering).
Note: the use case gives 4 legs, not 5. The implementation is correct with 4.
critical_code_review_comments: tripFold.foldTrip: the folded entry id is Date.now()+2 and the Arrived entry is Date.now()+1, both in the same mutate. This is fine, but ids could collide with other Date.now() based ids across quick successive mutates.

useAllDone.arrive: if ARRIVED is pressed twice on Arriving at Destination without a new departure, the second Arrived entry belongs to no leg, so it stays outside the fold. This is acceptable but worth knowing.
useAllDone.depart overwrites legs[trip] with [leg]. If a previous trip was never closed with Returning to Dock, its entries stay unfolded in the log (nothing is lost).
seed_data_creation: Temporary: /tmp/seed175.py on test-admin-1/main (arrivingDest 26 items, vessel/callsign, Route Plan today 08:00 -> tomorrow 18:00, Mana Marina->Tawa Bay, TEST_ log entry). Restored from /tmp/bk175/boat.json via mongoimport --mode=upsert. Verified: shipsLog 1, arrivingDest 5, legs absent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed with /tmp/seed175.py after backing up with mongoexport, and check with /tmp/chk175.py or /tmp/chk175b.py (full log detail). Pick lists with the list-selector, then list-option-<id> using scroll_into_view_if_needed (force click fails for options lower down). Levels are level-<fuel|gas|water|bat-engine|bat-house>-full and level-arrive-...-full (default batteries are engine and house). Interim dialog: route-start-input, route-dest-input, navigator-finish-at-time-input .fill('HH:MM') (finish date defaults to today; run before 23:50 UTC). To retest the fold bug: do a Returning to Dock ARRIVED with no trip, then DEPART, then Returning to Dock ARRIVED, and check the Trip entry doesn't contain the earlier arrival check.
rca of the issue: putLog(log, d, text, sig) returns the existing d.log_id when that entry is still in the log and log_sig is unchanged. boat.arrive and boat.depart are never reset at DEPART or after the fold; only interimDepart resets arrive. So the first arrival after DEPART can reuse a status entry logged before the trip, and arrive() adds arr.log_id to the leg's logs. foldTrip then removes that older entry from the log and folds it into the new trip. Reproduce: Returning to Dock ARRIVED with no legs, then DEPART, then Returning to Dock ARRIVED with the same levels. Fix: reset arrive (and keep depart fresh) in depart(), and clear log_id after the fold, or filter the fold to ids >= legs[0].id.
